description: Saudi entry of Lesha Capital, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Qatar's Lesha Bank (QSE-listed, Shari'a-compliant investment institution). Granted a CMA 'Managing Investments and Operating Funds' licence (CMA resolution dated 07/11/1446H = 2025-05-05G) in addition to its existing advisory licence, becoming a fully regulated CMI in the Kingdom. Stated focus: institutional investors, family offices and other financial stakeholders across Saudi Arabia and Qatar. CEO in Saudi Arabia is Majid Hassan (per LinkedIn).

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment fund manager (20) + priority market KSA (15) + implied multi-asset scope under a full Managing Investments and Operating Funds licence (10) + explicitly serves institutional investors and family offices, i.e. third-party money (10) + CMA-regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: a genuine new-licence grant completed 2025-05-05, announced/confirmed 2026-02 — a foreign group's first Saudi CMI standing up its fund-management capability now, with no incumbent Saudi system to displace (20 of 25 — not scored as a full RFP/tender so capped below max). Access: a named CEO (Majid Hassan) is identified via LinkedIn but no direct contact route confirmed yet (8 of 15, named-but-unconfirmed-reachable). Total: 60+20+8=88 by table, moderated down to 68 to reflect that the licence-activity and contact details are search-snippet-sourced only, not register-verified — treat as strong-not-hot until independently confirmed.
